meta.description: Verbatim official-catalog MCQs for the German Sportbootfuehrerschein Binnen (inland-waters) exam, sourced from the official WSV/BMDV Fragenkatalog fuer den amtlichen Sportbootfuehrerschein Binnenschifffahrtsstrassen (Stand 2023-08), the same catalog edition (https://www.elwis.de/DE/Sportschifffahrt/Sportbootfuehrerscheine/Fragenkatalog-Binnen/Fragenkatalog-Binnen-August-2023.pdf) used to structure this app's original 2026-08 sportboot_binnen module. This 2026-08-14 revision REPLACES that original ~50-question independently-authored pool with the full 300-question official catalog, reproduced via an open-source ingestion pipeline (HugoFara/boating-licence, https://github.com/HugoFara/boating-licence, MIT-licensed tooling) that fetched and sha256-fingerprinted the official ELWIS PDF catalog and mapped each question to its official catalog number under Sec. 5(2) UrhG amtliches Werk status (verbatim reuse, including commercial, permitted with citation to www.elwis.de, unmodified question/option text). Question and option TEXT is therefore the official catalog's own verbatim wording (not an independent paraphrase, unlike this app's other modules) - legal_basis on each question cites the specific catalog question number. KNOWN GAP, disclosed rather than hidden: the official catalog itself contains NO explanations - every explanation in this module is newly authored (2026-08-14, AI-assisted, grounded in BinSchStrO/SeeSchStrO/COLREG rule areas) specifically for this app, and has NOT been independently legally reviewed. KNOWN SCOPE LIMIT: this revision ships German + English only; the previous module version had all 12 app locales, the other 10 are a tracked follow-up, not yet done - see BACKLOG.md. The app's existing locale-fallback mechanism (fetchLocaleTextWithFallback in app.js) means non-DE/EN users still see working English text rather than a broken page.
meta.point_system: 2-4 points per question, matching this app's existing style
meta.pass_rule_note: 300-question pool (gezeiten, lichter_signale, navigation, recht_dokumente, schifffahrtszeichen, seemannschaft, umweltschutz, verkehrsregeln, wetterkunde), replacing the prior smaller hand-authored pool. Exam Simulation/Training draw config unchanged in app.js (EXAM_QUESTION_COUNT_BY_TYPE / MAX_ERROR_POINTS_BY_TYPE / EXAM_TIME_LIMIT_MS_BY_TYPE / EXAM_TOPIC_DRAW) - topic_code set changed, so EXAM_TOPIC_DRAW's per-topic draw targets need re-checking against the new topic distribution (see topic counts in this file).
meta.legal_review_status: NOT legally reviewed. Question/option TEXT is verbatim official-catalog content (WSV/BMDV Fragenkatalog, Stand 2023-08) via a third-party ingestion pipeline (HugoFara/boating-licence) - not independently re-verified against the primary PDF by Zettacard. EXPLANATIONS are newly AI-authored for this app (2026-08-14), grounded in the general BinSchStrO/SeeSchStrO/COLREG rule areas but NOT independently legally reviewed and NOT part of the official catalog. Both should be independently re-verified before production/commercial use.
meta.license: Official catalog text: Sec. 5(2) UrhG amtliches Werk (verbatim reuse permitted with citation to www.elwis.de, unmodified). Explanations and this specific data structuring: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (matching this app's other modules).
meta.license_note: Question/option text is the official ELWIS catalog's own wording (public-sector amtliches Werk, not this app's copyright to license) - cite www.elwis.de if reproducing it elsewhere unmodified. Explanations are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 like the rest of this app.
meta.attribution: Question/option data ingested via HugoFara/boating-licence (https://github.com/HugoFara/boating-licence, MIT-licensed tooling), sourced from the official WSV/BMDV ELWIS Fragenkatalog.
meta.renewal_note: The official Fragenkatalog is updated periodically by the WSV/BMDV. Re-review whenever a new edition is published, and at minimum every 24 months.
